0.0;\n    T c = 0.0;\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        T y = val - c;\n        T t = sum + y;\n        c = (t - sum) - y;\n        sum = t;\n    }\n    return sum;\n}\n\n// Print results for floating-point arrays\ntemplate <typename T>\nvoid print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = \"Result\") {\n    if (data.empty()) {\n        printf(\"=== RESULTS ===\\n\");\n statistics\n    T sum = kahan_sum(data);\n    T min_val = data[0];\n    T max_val = data[0];\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);\n        max_val = {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyZU4UfRaLG5mfcUU4CP","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01NJGfh6dGNw6NU6PnqHYMPY","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_hybrid_r2/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Share of each rank's rows that is relaxed by its host OpenMP threads; the\n// remaining rows are relaxed on the rank's GPU.\nconstexpr size_t HOST_ROW_PERCENT = 10;\n\n// Thread block shape for the GPU relaxation kernel\nconstexpr unsigned int BLOCK_X = 32;\nconstexpr unsigned int BLOCK_Y = 8;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                    \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\n// Fills the rows [rowBegin, rowBegin + rowCount) of the distance matrix. The\n// generator is advanced over the preceding rows, so every rank obtains exactly\n// the values the sequential generator produces for its rows.\nvoid initializeDistanceRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes,\n                            const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount,\n                            const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowBegin * numNodes; ++i) {\n        rand_r(&seed);\n    }\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowCount * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        dist[r * numNodes + rowBegin + r] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Path entries of global row i are initialized to i\nvoid initializePathRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes,\n                        const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount) {\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        std::fill_n(path.begin() + r * numNodes, numNodes, static_cast<unsigned int>(rowBegin + r));\n    }\n}\n\n// Relaxes the local rows on the GPU for intermediate node k. The pivot row\n// (row k of the distance matrix) is passed in separately.\n__global__ void relaxRowsKernel(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path,\n                                const unsigned int* pivotRow,\n                                const size_t rows, const size_t numNodes,\n                                const unsigned int k) {\n    const size_t j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t i = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    if (i >= rows || j >= numNodes) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // dist[i][k] is not changed during iteration k, since dist[k][k] == 0\n    unsigned int* rowI = dist + i * numNodes;\n    const unsigned int newDist = rowI[k] + pivotRow[j];\n    if (newDist < rowI[j]) {\n        rowI[j] = newDist;\n        path[i * numNodes + j] = k;\n    }\n}\n\n// Relaxes the local rows on the host CPU for intermediate node k\nvoid relaxRowsHost(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path, const unsigned int* pivotRow,\n                   const size_t rows, const size_t numNodes, const unsigned int k) {\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {\n        unsigned int* rowI = dist + i * numNodes;\n        unsigned int* pathI = path + i * numNodes;\n        const unsigned int distIK = rowI[k];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n            const unsigned int newDist = distIK + pivotRow[j];\n            const bool improved = newDist < rowI[j];\n            rowI[j] = improved ? newDist : rowI[j];\n            pathI[j] = improved ? k : pathI[j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm on the rows owned by this rank. Iteration k\n// broadcasts pivot row k from its owner, then every rank relaxes its rows.\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,\n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path,\n                   unsigned int* dDist, unsigned int* dPath, unsigned int* dPivot,\n                   const std::vector<size_t>& rowStarts,\n                   const int rank, const size_t numNodes) {\n    const size_t rowBegin = rowStarts[rank];\n    const size_t rowCount = rowStarts[rank + 1] - rowBegin;\n    const size_t hostRows = rowCount * HOST_ROW_PERCENT / 100;\n    const size_t gpuRows = rowCount - hostRows;\n\n    const dim3 block(BLOCK_X, BLOCK_Y);\n    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((numNodes + BLOCK_X - 1) / BLOCK_X),\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>((gpuRows + BLOCK_Y - 1) / BLOCK_Y));\n\n    std::vector<unsigned int> pivotRow(numNodes);\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // Owner rank: the last rank whose first row is not after k\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(rowStarts.begin(), rowStarts.end(), k)\n                                           - rowStarts.begin()) - 1;\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            const size_t localRow = k - rowBegin;\n            if (localRow < gpuRows) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(pivotRow.data(), dDist + localRow * numNodes,\n                                      numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            } else {\n                std::copy_n(dist.data() + localRow * numNodes, numNodes, pivotRow.begin());\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(pivotRow.data(), static_cast<int>(numNodes), MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (gpuRows > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPivot, pivotRow.data(), numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            relaxRowsKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dDist, dPath, dPivot, gpuRows, numNodes,\n                                             static_cast<unsigned int>(k));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n\n        // Runs concurrently with the kernel above\n        relaxRowsHost(dist.data() + gpuRows * numNodes, path.data() + gpuRows * numNodes,\n                      pivotRow.data(), hostRows, numNodes, static_cast<unsigned int>(k));\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n\n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n\n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\",\n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Bind each rank to a GPU on its node\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    int localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(nodeComm, &localSize);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices available on rank %d\\n\", rank);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount));\n\n    // Host threads of the ranks on a node share its cores\n    omp_set_num_threads(std::max(1, omp_get_num_procs() / localSize));\n\n    // Balanced contiguous row blocks: rank r owns rows [rowStarts[r], rowStarts[r+1])\n    std::vector<size_t> rowStarts(size + 1);\n    for (int r = 0; r <= size; ++r) {\n        rowStarts[r] = numNodes * static_cast<size_t>(r) / static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    }\n    const size_t rowBegin = rowStarts[rank];\n    const size_t rowCount = rowStarts[rank + 1] - rowBegin;\n    const size_t gpuRows = rowCount - rowCount * HOST_ROW_PERCENT / 100;\n\n    // Allocate matrices (local rows only). The\n// generator is advanced over the preceding rows, so every rank obtains exactly\n// the values the sequential generator produces for its rows.\nvoid initializeDistanceRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes,\n                            const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount,\n                            const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowBegin * numNodes; ++i) {\n        rand_r(&seed);\n    }\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowCount * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        dist[r * numNodes + rowBegin + r] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Path entries of global row i are initialized to i\nvoid initializePathRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes,\n                        const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount) {\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        std::fill_n(path.begin() + r * numNodes, numNodes, static_cast<unsigned int>(rowBegin + r));\n    }\n}\n\n// Relaxes the local rows on the GPU for intermediate node k. The pivot row\n// (row k of the distance matrix) is passed in separately.\n__global__ void relaxRowsKernel(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path,\n                                const unsigned int* pivotRow,\n                                const size_t rows, const size_t numNodes,\n                                const unsigned int k) {\n    const size_t j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t i = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    if (i >= rows || j >= numNodes) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // dist[i][k] is not changed during iteration k, since dist[k][k] == 0\n    unsigned int* rowI = dist + i * numNodes;\n    const unsigned int newDist = rowI[k] + pivotRow[j];\n    if (newDist < rowI[j]) {\n        rowI[j] = newDist;\n        path[i * numNodes + j] = k;\n    }\n}\n\n// Relaxes the local rows on the host CPU for intermediate node k\nvoid relaxRowsHost(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path, const unsigned int* pivotRow,\n                   const size_t rows, const size_t numNodes, const unsigned int k) {\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {\n        unsigned int* rowI = dist + i * numNodes;\n        unsigned int* pathI = path + i * numNodes;\n        const unsigned int distIK = rowI[k];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n            const unsigned int newDist = distIK + pivotRow[j];\n            const bool improved = newDist < rowI[j];\n            rowI[j] = improved ? newDist : rowI[j];\n            pathI[j] = improved ? k : pathI[j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm on the rows owned by this rank. Iteration k\n// broadcasts pivot row k from its owner, then every rank relaxes its rows.\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,\n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path,\n                   unsigned int* dDist, unsigned int* dPath, unsigned int* dPivot,\n                   const std::vector<size_t>& rowStarts,\n                   const int rank, const size_t numNodes) {\n    const size_t rowBegin = rowStarts[rank];\n    const size_t rowCount = rowStarts[rank + 1] - rowBegin;\n    const size_t hostRows = rowCount * HOST_ROW_PERCENT / 100;\n    const size_t gpuRows = rowCount - hostRows;\n\n    const dim3 block(BLOCK_X, BLOCK_Y);\n    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((numNodes + BLOCK_X - 1) / BLOCK_X),\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>((gpuRows + BLOCK_Y - 1) / BLOCK_Y));\n\n    std::vector<unsigned int> pivotRow(numNodes);\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // Owner rank: the last rank whose first row is not after k\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(rowStarts.begin(), rowStarts.end(), k)\n                                           - rowStarts.begin()) - 1;\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            const size_t localRow = k - rowBegin;\n            if (localRow < gpuRows) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(pivotRow.data(), dDist + localRow * numNodes,\n                                      numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            } else {\n                std::copy_n(dist.data() + localRow * numNodes, numNodes, pivotRow.begin());\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(pivotRow.data(), static_cast<int>(numNodes), MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (gpuRows > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPivot, pivotRow.data(), numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            relaxRowsKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dDist, dPath, dPivot, gpuRows, numNodes,\n                                             static_cast<unsigned int>(k));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n\n        // Runs concurrently with the kernel above\n        relaxRowsHost(dist.data() + gpuRows * numNodes, path.data() + gpuRows * numNodes,\n                      pivotRow.data(), hostRows, numNodes, static_cast<unsigned int>(k));\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n\n    // 1. The\n// generator is advanced over the preceding rows, so every rank obtains exactly\n// the values the sequential generator produces for its rows.\nvoid initializeDistanceRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes,\n                            const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount,\n                            const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowBegin * numNodes; ++i) {\n        rand_r(&seed);\n    }\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowCount * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        dist[r * numNodes + rowBegin + r] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Path entries of global row i are initialized to i\nvoid initializePathRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes,\n                        const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount) {\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        std::fill_n(path.begin() + r * numNodes, numNodes, static_cast<unsigned int>(rowBegin + r));\n    }\n}\n\n// Relaxes the local rows on the GPU for intermediate node k. The pivot row\n// (row k of the distance matrix) is passed in separately.\n__global__ void relaxRowsKernel(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path,\n                                const unsigned int* pivotRow,\n                                const size_t rows, const size_t numNodes,\n                                const unsigned int k) {\n    const size_t j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t i = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    if (i >= rows || j >= numNodes) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // dist[i][k] is not changed during iteration k, since dist[k][k] == 0\n    unsigned int* rowI = dist + i * numNodes;\n    const unsigned int newDist = rowI[k] + pivotRow[j];\n    if (newDist < rowI[j]) {\n        rowI[j] = newDist;\n        path[i * numNodes + j] = k;\n    }\n}\n\n// Relaxes the local rows on the host CPU for intermediate node k\nvoid relaxRowsHost(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path, const unsigned int* pivotRow,\n                   const size_t rows, const size_t numNodes, const unsigned int k) {\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {\n        unsigned int* rowI = dist + i * numNodes;\n        unsigned int* pathI = path + i * numNodes;\n        const unsigned int distIK = rowI[k];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n            const unsigned int newDist = distIK + pivotRow[j];\n            const bool improved = newDist < rowI[j];\n            rowI[j] = improved ? newDist : rowI[j];\n            pathI[j] = improved ? k : pathI[j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm on the rows owned by this rank. Iteration k\n// broadcasts pivot row k from its owner, then every rank relaxes its rows.\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,\n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path,\n                   unsigned int* dDist, unsigned int* dPath, unsigned int* dPivot,\n                   const std::vector<size_t>& rowStarts,\n                   const int rank, const size_t numNodes, const size_t gpuRows) {\n    const size_t rowBegin = rowStarts[rank];\n    const size_t hostRows = rowStarts[rank + 1] - rowBegin - gpuRows;\n\n    const dim3 block(BLOCK_X, BLOCK_Y);\n    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((numNodes + BLOCK_X - 1) / BLOCK_X),\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>((gpuRows + BLOCK_Y - 1) / BLOCK_Y));\n\n    std::vector<unsigned int> pivotRow(numNodes);\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // Owner rank: the last rank whose first row is not after k\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(rowStarts.begin(), rowStarts.end(), k)\n                                           - rowStarts.begin()) - 1;\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            const size_t localRow = k - rowBegin;\n            if (localRow < gpuRows) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(pivotRow.data(), dDist + localRow * numNodes,\n                                      numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            } else {\n                std::copy_n(dist.data() + localRow * numNodes, numNodes, pivotRow.begin());\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(pivotRow.data(), static_cast<int>(numNodes), MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (gpuRows > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPivot, pivotRow.data(), numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            relaxRowsKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dDist, dPath, dPivot, gpuRows, numNodes,\n                                             static_cast<unsigned int>(k));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n\n        // Runs concurrently with the kernel above\n        relaxRowsHost(dist.data() + gpuRows * numNodes, path.data() + gpuRows * numNodes,\n                      pivotRow.data(), hostRows, numNodes, static_cast<unsigned int>(k));\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n\n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n\n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\",\n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Bind each rank to a GPU on its node\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    int localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(nodeComm, &localSize);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices available on rank %d\\n\", rank);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount));\n\n    // Host threads of the ranks on a node share its cores\n    omp_set_num_threads(std::max(1, omp_get_num_procs() / localSize));\n\n    // Balanced contiguous row blocks: rank r owns rows [rowStarts[r], rowStarts[r+1])\n    std::vector<size_t> rowStarts(size + 1);\n    for (int r = 0; r <= size; ++r) {\n        rowStarts[r] = numNodes * static_cast<size_t>(r) / static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    }\n    const size_t rowBegin = rowStarts[rank];\n    const size_t rowCount = rowStarts[rank + 1] - rowBegin;\n    const size_t gpuRows = rowCount - rowCount * HOST_ROW_PERCENT / 100;\n\n    // Allocate matrices (local rows only). Rows [0, gpuRows) live on the GPU\n    // while the computation runs; the rest stay in host memory.\n    std::vector<unsigned int> dist(rowCount * numNodes);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> path(rowCount * numNodes);\n\n    // Initialize\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Initializing graph...\\n\");\n    }\n    initializeDistanceRows(dist, numNodes, rowBegin, rowCount, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);\n    initializePathRows(path, numNodes, rowBegin, rowCount);\n\n    const size_t gpuBytes = gpuRows * numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int);\n    unsigned int* dDist = nullptr;\n    unsigned int* dPath = nullptr;\n    unsigned int* dPivot = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPivot, numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int)));\n    if (gpuRows > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dDist, gpuBytes));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPath, gpuBytes));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dDist, dist.data(), gpuBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPath, path.data(), gpuBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    // Run Floyd-Warshall\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computing shortest paths...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    floydWarshall(dist, path, dDist, dPath, dPivot, rowStarts, rank, numNodes);\n\n    // Bring the GPU part of the result back to the host\n    if (gpuRows > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dist.data(), dDist, gpuBytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    long long localMs = duration.count();\n    long long maxMs = 0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localMs, &maxMs, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (gpuRows > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dDist));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPath));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPivot));\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %lld ms\\n\", maxMs);\n\n        // Calculate operations per second\n        // Floyd-Warshall has O(n³) complexity\n        double ops = (double)numNodes * numNodes * numNodes;\n        double gflops = ops / (maxMs / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Gather the full distance matrix on the root for output and validation\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        std::vector<unsigned int> fullDist(root ? numNodes * numNodes : 0);\n        std::vector<int> counts(size);\n        std::vector<int> displs(size);\n        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>((rowStarts[r + 1] - the\n// remaining rows are relaxed on the rank's GPU.\nconstexpr size_t HOST_ROW_PERCENT = 10;\n\n// Thread block shape for the GPU relaxation kernel\nconstexpr unsigned int BLOCK_X = 32;\nconstexpr unsigned int BLOCK_Y = 8;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                    \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\n// Fills the rows [rowBegin, rowBegin + rowCount) of the distance matrix. The\n// generator is advanced over the preceding rows, so every rank obtains exactly\n// the values the sequential generator produces for its rows.\nvoid initializeDistanceRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes,\n                            const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount,\n                            const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowBegin * numNodes; ++i) {\n        rand_r(&seed);\n    }\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowCount * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        dist[r * numNodes + rowBegin + r] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Path entries of global row i are initialized to i\nvoid initializePathRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes,\n                        const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount) {\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        std::fill_n(path.begin() + r * numNodes, numNodes, static_cast<unsigned int>(rowBegin + r));\n    }\n}\n\n// Relaxes the local rows on the GPU for intermediate node k. The pivot row\n// (row k of the distance matrix) is passed in separately.\n__global__ void relaxRowsKernel(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path,\n                                const unsigned int* pivotRow,\n                                const size_t rows, const size_t numNodes,\n                                const unsigned int k) {\n    const size_t j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t i = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    if (i >= rows || j >= numNodes) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // dist[i][k] is not changed during iteration k, since dist[k][k] == 0\n    unsigned int* rowI = dist + i * numNodes;\n    const unsigned int newDist = rowI[k] + pivotRow[j];\n    if (newDist < rowI[j]) {\n        rowI[j] = newDist;\n        path[i * numNodes + j] = k;\n    }\n}\n\n// Relaxes the local rows on the host CPU for intermediate node k\nvoid relaxRowsHost(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path, const unsigned int* pivotRow,\n                   const size_t rows, const size_t numNodes, const unsigned int k) {\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {\n        unsigned int* rowI = dist + i * numNodes;\n        unsigned int* pathI = path + i * numNodes;\n        const unsigned int distIK = rowI[k];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n            const unsigned int newDist = distIK + pivotRow[j];\n            const bool improved = newDist < rowI[j];\n            rowI[j] = improved ? newDist : rowI[j];\n            pathI[j] = improved ? k : pathI[j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm on the rows owned by this rank. Iteration k\n// broadcasts pivot row k from its owner, then every rank relaxes its rows.\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,\n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path,\n                   unsigned int* dDist, unsigned int* dPath, unsigned int* dPivot,\n                   const std::vector<size_t>& rowStarts,\n                   const int rank, const size_t numNodes, const size_t gpuRows) {\n    const size_t rowBegin = rowStarts[rank];\n    const size_t hostRows = rowStarts[rank + 1] - rowBegin - gpuRows;\n\n    const dim3 block(BLOCK_X, BLOCK_Y);\n    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((numNodes + BLOCK_X - 1) / BLOCK_X),\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>((gpuRows + BLOCK_Y - 1) / BLOCK_Y));\n\n    std::vector<unsigned int> pivotRow(numNodes);\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // Owner rank: the last rank whose first row is not after k\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(rowStarts.begin(), rowStarts.end(), k)\n                                           - rowStarts.begin()) - 1;\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            const size_t localRow = k - rowBegin;\n            if (localRow < gpuRows) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(pivotRow.data(), dDist + localRow * numNodes,\n                                      numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            } else {\n                std::copy_n(dist.data() + localRow * numNodes, numNodes, pivotRow.begin());\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(pivotRow.data(), static_cast<int>(numNodes), MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (gpuRows > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPivot, pivotRow.data(), numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            relaxRowsKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dDist, dPath, dPivot, gpuRows, numNodes,\n                                             static_cast<unsigned int>(k));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n\n        // Runs concurrently with the kernel above\n        relaxRowsHost(dist.data() + gpuRows * numNodes, path.data() + gpuRows * numNodes,\n                      pivotRow.data(), hostRows, numNodes, static_cast<unsigned int>(k));\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n\n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n\n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\",\n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Bind each rank to a GPU on its node\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    int localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(nodeComm, &localSize);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices available on rank %d\\n\", rank);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount));\n\n    // Host threads of the ranks on a node share its cores\n    omp_set_num_threads(std::max(1, omp_get_num_procs() / localSize));\n\n    // Balanced contiguous row blocks: rank r owns rows [rowStarts[r], rowStarts[r+1])\n    std::vector<size_t> rowStarts(size + 1);\n    for (int r = 0; Rows [0, gpuRows) live on the GPU\n    // while the computation runs; the rest stay in host memory.\n    std::vector<unsigned int> dist(rowCount * numNodes);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> path(rowCount * numNodes);\n\n    // Initialize\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Initializing graph...\\n\");\n    }\n    initializeDistanceRows(dist, numNodes, rowBegin, rowCount, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);\n    initializePathRows(path, numNodes, rowBegin, rowCount);\n\n    const size_t gpuBytes = gpuRows * numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int);\n    unsigned int* dDist = nullptr;\n    unsigned int* dPath = nullptr;\n    unsigned int* dPivot = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPivot, numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int)));\n    if (gpuRows > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dDist, gpuBytes));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPath, gpuBytes));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dDist, dist.data(), gpuBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPath, path.data(), gpuBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    // Run Floyd-Warshall\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computing shortest paths...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    floydWarshall(dist, path, dDist, dPath, dPivot, rowStarts, rank, numNodes, gpuRows);\n\n    // Bring the GPU part of the result back to the host\n    if (gpuRows > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dist.data(), dDist, gpuBytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    long long localMs = duration.count();\n    long long maxMs = 0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localMs, &maxMs, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (gpuRows > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dDist));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPath));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPivot));\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %lld ms\\n\", maxMs);\n\n        // Calculate operations per second\n        // Floyd-Warshall has O(n³) complexity\n        double ops = (double)numNodes * numNodes * numNodes;\n        double gflops = ops / (maxMs / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Gather the full distance matrix on the root for output and validation\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        std::vector<unsigned int> fullDist(root ? numNodes * numNodes : 0);\n        std::vector<int> counts(size);\n        std::vector<int> displs(size);\n        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>((rowStarts[r + 1] - OpenMP still has to do real work, though, and the better use is as the driver for multiple GPUs in one process:\n\n- Each rank's rows are split into contiguous sub-blocks, one per GPU, and each OpenMP thread drives one GPU.\n- Per step `k`, the owner thread copies pivot row `k` to a host buffer, and the master thread broadcasts it over MPI. start).count();\n}","originalFile":"#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Thread block shape for the GPU relaxation kernel\nconstexpr unsigned int BLOCK_X = 32;\nconstexpr unsigned int BLOCK_Y = 8;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                    \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\n// Fills the rows [rowBegin, rowBegin + rowCount) of the distance matrix. The\n// generator is advanced over the preceding rows, so every rank obtains exactly\n// the values the sequential generator produces for its rows.\nvoid initializeDistanceRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes,\n                            const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount,\n                            const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowBegin * numNodes; ++i) {\n        rand_r(&seed);\n    }\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowCount * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        dist[r * numNodes + rowBegin + r] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Path entries of global row i are initialized to i\nvoid initializePathRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes,\n                        const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount) {\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        std::fill_n(path.begin() + r * numNodes, numNodes, static_cast<unsigned int>(rowBegin + r));\n    }\n}\n\n// Relaxes the local rows on the GPU for intermediate node k. r <= size; ++r) {\n        rowStarts[r] = numNodes * static_cast<size_t>(r) / static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    }\n    const size_t rowBegin = rowStarts[rank];\n    const size_t rowCount = rowStarts[rank + 1] - rowBegin;\n    const size_t gpuRows = rowCount - rowCount * HOST_ROW_PERCENT / 100;\n\n    // Allocate matrices (local rows only). The\n// generator is advanced over the preceding rows, so every rank obtains exactly\n// the values the sequential generator produces for its rows.\nvoid initializeDistanceRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes,\n                            const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount,\n                            const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowBegin * numNodes; ++i) {\n        rand_r(&seed);\n    }\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowCount * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        dist[r * numNodes + rowBegin + r] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Path entries of global row i are initialized to i\nvoid initializePathRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes,\n                        const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount) {\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        std::fill_n(path.begin() + r * numNodes, numNodes, static_cast<unsigned int>(rowBegin + r));\n    }\n}\n\n// Relaxes the local rows on the GPU for intermediate node k.                                                \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                    \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\n// Fills the rows [rowBegin, rowBegin + rowCount) of the distance matrix. The\n// generator is advanced over the preceding rows, so every rank obtains exactly\n// the values the sequential generator produces for its rows.\nvoid initializeDistanceRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes,\n                            const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount,\n                            const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowBegin * numNodes; ++i) {\n        rand_r(&seed);\n    }\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowCount * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        dist[r * numNodes + rowBegin + r] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Path entries of global row i are initialized to i\nvoid initializePathRows(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes,\n                        const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount) {\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < rowCount; ++r) {\n        std::fill_n(path.begin() + r * numNodes, numNodes, static_cast<unsigned int>(rowBegin + r));\n    }\n}\n\n// Relaxes the local rows on the GPU for intermediate node k. The pivot row\n// (row k of the distance matrix) is passed in separately.\n__global__ void relaxRowsKernel(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path,\n                                const unsigned int* pivotRow,\n                                const size_t rows, const size_t numNodes,\n                                const unsigned int k) {\n    const size_t j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t i = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    if (i >= rows || j >= numNodes) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // dist[i][k] is not changed during iteration k, since dist[k][k] == 0\n    unsigned int* rowI = dist + i * numNodes;\n    const unsigned int newDist = rowI[k] + pivotRow[j];\n    if (newDist < rowI[j]) {\n        rowI[j] = newDist;\n        path[i * numNodes + j] = k;\n    }\n}\n\n// Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm on the rows owned by this rank. The rows are\n// split into contiguous sub-blocks, one per GPU, and each OpenMP thread drives\n// one GPU. In iteration k the owner of row k copies it to the host, MPI\n// broadcasts it between ranks, and every GPU relaxes its rows against it.\n// Returns the computation time of this rank in milliseconds.\nlong long floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,\n                        std::vector<unsigned int>& path,\n                        const std::vector<size_t>& rowStarts,\n                        const int rank, const size_t numNodes,\n                        const int numThreads, const int firstDevice, const int deviceCount) {\n    const size_t rowBegin = rowStarts[rank];\n    const size_t rowCount = rowStarts[rank + 1] - rowBegin;\n\n    // Local rows [threadStarts[t], threadStarts[t+1]) belong to thread t\n    std::vector<size_t> threadStarts(numThreads + 1);\n    for (int t = 0; t <= numThreads; ++t) {\n        threadStarts[t] = rowCount * t / numThreads;\n    }\n\n    // Pivot row buffers, alternated by parity of k so that the copy for\n    // iteration k+1 cannot overwrite the row still read by iteration k\n    std::vector<unsigned int> pivotRows(2 * numNodes);\n\n    std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::time_point start;\n    std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::time_point end;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel num_threads(numThreads)\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n        const size_t firstRow = threadStarts[tid];\n        const size_t subRows = threadStarts[tid + 1] - firstRow;\n        const size_t bytes = subRows * numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int);\n\n        // Non-blocking stream, so that the host only waits where the owner needs a row\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice((firstDevice + tid) % deviceCount));\n        cudaStream_t stream;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n        unsigned int* dDist = nullptr;\n        unsigned int* dPath = nullptr;\n        unsigned int* dPivot = nullptr;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPivot, numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int)));\n        if (subRows > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dDist, bytes));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPath, bytes));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dDist, dist.data() + firstRow * numNodes, bytes,\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dPath, path.data() + firstRow * numNodes, bytes,\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));\n\n        #pragma omp barrier\n        #pragma omp master\n        {\n            MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n        }\n        #pragma omp barrier\n\n        const dim3 block(BLOCK_X, BLOCK_Y);\n        const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((numNodes + BLOCK_X - 1) / BLOCK_X),\n                        static_cast<unsigned int>((subRows + BLOCK_Y - 1) / BLOCK_Y));\n\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n            const int owner = static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(rowStarts.begin(), rowStarts.end(), k)\n                                               - rowStarts.begin()) - 1;\n            const size_t localK = k - rowBegin;\n            unsigned int* pivotRow = pivotRows.data() + (k & 1) * numNodes;\n\n            // The thread whose GPU holds row k on the owner rank copies it to the host\n            if (rank == owner && localK >= firstRow && localK < firstRow + subRows) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(pivotRow, dDist + (localK - firstRow) * numNodes,\n                                           numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int),\n                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n            #pragma omp master\n            {\n                MPI_Bcast(pivotRow, static_cast<int>(numNodes), MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            }\n            #pragma omp barrier\n\n            // Pageable source: the copy is staged before the call returns, so the\n            // host buffer can be reused by the broadcast of a later iteration\n            if (subRows > 0) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dPivot, pivotRow, numNodes * sizeof(unsigned int),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n                relaxRowsKernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(dDist, dPath, dPivot, subRows, numNodes,\n                                                            static_cast<unsigned int>(k));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Bring the result back to the host\n        if (subRows > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dist.data() + firstRow * numNodes, dDist, bytes,\n                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));\n        if (subRows > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dDist));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPath));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPivot));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));\n\n        #pragma omp barrier\n        #pragma omp master\n        {\n            end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n        }\n    }\n\n    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n\n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n\n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\",\n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    // Only the thread that drives OpenMP's master role makes MPI calls\n    int provided = 0;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n    if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"MPI does not provide MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Each rank drives the GPUs of its node, sharing them with the other ranks\n    // on the node when there are more ranks than devices\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    int localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(nodeComm, &localSize);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices available on rank %d\\n\", rank);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    const int devicesPerRank = std::max(1, deviceCount / localSize);\n    const int firstDevice = (localRank * devicesPerRank) % deviceCount;\n\n    // Balanced contiguous row blocks: rank r owns rows [rowStarts[r], rowStarts[r+1])\n    std::vector<size_t> rowStarts(size + 1);\n    for (int r = 0; r <= size; ++r) {\n        rowStarts[r] = numNodes * static_cast<size_t>(r) / static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    }\n    const size_t rowBegin = rowStarts[rank];\n    const size_t rowCount = rowStarts[rank + 1] - rowBegin;\n\n    // Allocate matrices (local rows only)\n    std::vector<unsigned int> dist(rowCount * numNodes);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> path(rowCount * numNodes);\n\n    // Initialize\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Initializing graph...\\n\");\n    }\n    initializeDistanceRows(dist, numNodes, rowBegin, rowCount, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);\n    initializePathRows(path, numNodes, rowBegin, rowCount);\n\n    // Run Floyd-Warshall\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computing shortest paths...\\n\");\n    }\n    const long long localMs = floydWarshall(dist, path, rowStarts, rank, numNodes,\n                                            devicesPerRank, firstDevice, deviceCount);\n    long long maxMs = 0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localMs, &maxMs, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %lld ms\\n\", maxMs);\n\n        // Calculate operations per second\n        // Floyd-Warshall has O(n³) complexity\n        double ops = (double)numNodes * numNodes * numNodes;\n        double gflops = ops / (maxMs / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Gather the full distance matrix on the root for output and validation\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        std::vector<unsigned int> fullDist(root ? numNodes * numNodes : 0);\n        std::vector<int> counts(size);\n        std::vector<int> displs(size);\n        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>((rowStarts[r + 1] - rowStarts[r]) * numNodes);\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(rowStarts[r] * numNodes);\n        }\n        MPI_Gatherv(dist.data(), static_cast<int>(rowCount * numNodes), MPI_UNSIGNED,\n                    fullDist.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_UNSIGNED, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (root) {\n            // Print results for external validation (integer hash-based)\n            if (printResults) {\n                print_results_int(fullDist, \"DistanceMatrix\");\n            }\n\n            // Validation\n            if (validate) {\n                printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n                bool valid = validateResult(fullDist, numNodes);\n\n                if (valid) {\n                    printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n                } else {\n                    printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n                    exitCode = 1;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return exitCode;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":89,"oldLines":6,"newStart":89,"newLines":8,"lines":[" // split into contiguous sub-blocks, one per GPU, and each OpenMP thread drives"," // one GPU. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfycYL2mKakNjj776K4PE","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The Floyd-Warshall benchmark now runs as a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program. It builds without warnings, and its output matches the original (same hashes, min/max, samples and validation) at every size and rank count I tested.\n\n**Design**\n- **MPI** splits the rows into contiguous blocks across ranks. At each step `k`, the owner of pivot row `k` broadcasts it, and every rank relaxes its own rows, so no other communication is needed.\n- **OpenMP** runs one driver thread per GPU in each rank. Barriers order the pivot handoff, and the pivot buffer is double-buffered by `k` parity so a write for `k+1` can't race with reads for `k`.\n- **CUDA** runs one relaxation kernel per `k` on each GPU's sub-block. The kernel is in `floydwarshall.cpp`, which CMake compiles as CUDA, so no new `.cu` file was needed.\n- Each rank generates only its own rows, advancing the same `rand_r` stream, so the initial matrix is bit-identical to the original.\n- `path` is maintained on the GPUs as before, though it is never printed.\n\n**Choices I made**\n- **CPU share dropped.** My first version gave the host CPU a slice of rows alongside the GPU. It was slower at every share I tried, because the per-step OpenMP fork/join costs more than the few rows it computes. OpenMP now drives the GPUs instead.\n- **Architectures** default to `70;80;86;90`, overridable with `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES`.\n- **No CPU fallback.** Per your request, the program requires GPUs and aborts without them.\n\n**Verification**\n- Compared the printed hash, min/max, samples and validation against the original build for n = 0, 1, 2, 3, 10, 100, 512, 1000, 1023 with 1–4 ranks.\n- Dumped the full path matrix from a scratch copy and compared it against the original for several sizes and rank counts, all identical.\n\n**Performance** (min of 3 runs, RTX 3090 ×4, one node)\n\n| n | 1 rank, 4 GPUs | 2 ranks | 4 ranks |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 512 | 11 ms | 11 ms | 12 ms |\n| 1024 | 24 ms | 28 ms | 29 ms |\n| 2048 | 64 ms | 80 ms | 87 ms |\n| 4096 | 249 ms | 281 ms | 256 ms |\n\nThe original takes 165 ms at n=512 and 1145 ms at n=1000 on this machine. The machine is shared, so the numbers above come from the quieter periods. Heavy load inflated some runs by 4–10×.\n\n**Launch requirement:** run with `mpirun --bind-to none` (or the equivalent for your launcher). Open MPI's default core binding pins each rank to one core, which serializes the driver threads and roughly doubles the time at n=2048. This is noted in the code comment.\n\n**Known limit:** the kernel makes one full pass over the matrix per `k`, so it is memory-bound. A blocked, shared-memory formulation would go further, but it is a substantially larger change, and I did not attempt it.\n\nI did not commit anything, since this directory is not a git repository."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1346,"cache_read_input_tokens":125477,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1346},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b940743a-ca28-4101-b315-850e00da12bc","uuid":"8237ab25-ba26-4fb2-b1ea-dc47c13e2170","timestamp":"2026-10-13T04:34:51.930Z","request_id":"req_011CfycYKYz1uVH6Se26f3Et"}
